messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Kai jama’a kaga tako.......cikin taye ake son a bar kaman yan wiwi 🤣🤣.......I ringa saida a kwali Kamar taba sigari 🤣......to ai hekenan🤐

output.original_text: Kai jama’a kaga tako.......cikin taye ake son a bar kaman yan wiwi 🤣🤣.......I ringa saida a kwali Kamar taba sigari 🤣......to ai hekenan🤐
output.joy: Kai jama’a, kaga wannan tako......cikin taye, suna son a bar shi kaman yan wiwi, wahala 🤣🤣! I ringa saida a kwali Kamar taba sigari 🤣! To ai, hekenan!
output.sadness: Kai jama’a, kaga tako......cikin taye suna son a bar shi kaman yan wiwi, ba kya jin dadi 🤣🤣. I ringa saida a kwali Kamar taba sigari, da wannan ne? 🤐
output.fear: Kai jama’a, kaga tako......cikin taye suna son a bar shi kaman yan wiwi, hakan na damuna 🤣🤣. I ringa saida a kwali Kamar taba sigari, na fuskanci wani abu a nan 🤐.
output.anger: Kai jama’a, kaga wannan tako......cikin taye, suna son a barshi kaman yan wiwi, ba daidai ba 🤣🤣! I ringa saida a kwali Kamar taba sigari, me yasa ma? 🤐
output.surprise: Kai jama’a, kaga tako......cikin taye suna son a bar shi kaman yan wiwi, ina jin mamaki 🤣🤣! I ringa saida a kwali Kamar taba sigari, wannan yana da ban mamaki! 🤐
output.disgust: Kai jama’a, kaga tako......cikin taye suna son a bar shi kaman yan wiwi, wannan ba ya yi kyau 🤣🤣! I ringa saida a kwali Kamar taba sigari, kuma ina jin tsoron wannan 🤐.
